# CSE455 coverage — joint proposal (Hana + Priya)

**Standing rule (office hours and quiz sections alike):** every CSE455 slot has a named owner for the term and a named first substitute per slot. The substitute is called only when the owner says so, by 09:00 on the morning of. No general "ask around".

**Office hours (Hana)**
1. Every slot has a named owner and named substitute, per the rule above.
2. Missed slot: owner says so by 09:00, substitute takes it. If neither can, cancelled on the course board at least two hours ahead and students pointed at the asynchronous route.
